Genomic heritability of egg weight in Gallus gallus: a GBLUP study

Wei Li 1,  Jane A Smith12
  • 1 College of Animal Science, Example University, Beijing, China.
  • PMID: 40000001
  • PMCID: PMC11000001
  • DOI: 10.1186/s12711-025-00001-2

Abstract

Background: Egg weight (EW) is a key trait with heritability reported between 0.4 and 0.6.

Results: Using 12,000 SNPs we estimated h2 = 0.45.

Conclusions: Genomic selection for EW is feasible.

Keywords: GBLUP; Egg weight; Heritability.
